author: Moanwar
body:
This PR is intended to reduce the size of a few branches in the offline TICL NanoAOD without losing any information. Instead of saving the muon information for every GeneralTrack row, save one row per actual muon in a new TrackMuon table, with a trackIdx pointing back to the corresponding GeneralTrack (`-1` if unresolved).
This PR also fixes a minor issue in TICLCandidateProducer where the muon PID was assigned incorrectly. Muons with a track charge of -1 were assigned a PID of -13 instead of `13`. This is now fixed.

The PR has been tested with the relevant workflows and runs smoothly for 34506.213 and 34706.213.
title: Improve the offline nanoAOD TICL muon tracks info
